mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP3A4, potentially increasing lansoprazole levels; lansoprazole may also inhibit disulfiram metabolism via CYP3A4.
action: Monitor for increased lansoprazole adverse effects (headache, diarrhea); consider dose reduction of lansoprazole if toxicity occurs; ensure disulfiram efficacy is maintained.
